data.description:
Exquisite disasters is a study in slow-motion collapse. It is a lyrical autopsy of how the mundane—a grocery list, a sharp sigh—eventually turns into a crack too big to fix.

The track balances lush, jangly indie-pop against a primitive garage powertrio rhythm section. I wanted to capture the "fragile but grand" energy of a domestic 1991 cassette demo that accidentally found its way into a professional studio for a few final overdubs.

For fans of: The Smiths, The La’s, and mid-90s Radiohead.

Vocalists: I am looking for a singer to collaborate on future projects in this specific style. If this sound resonates with you, let’s talk.

Credits:

Written & produced by: Sondersted
Label: Isle Valley Records

Tags:
Alternative, Indie Rock, Dream Pop, Sugargrapes, Isle valley records, Jangle pop, Lo-fi, Melancholy, 90s Indie, Nostalgic, Radiohead style, The Smiths style, Atmospheric.

data.description:
Bloom Ciphers follows a satirical passive/agressive narrative of floral sabotage conducted with total, deadpan sincerity. The story follows a war of secret meanings where "Forever yours" is met with a black forget-me-not, and snapdragons are sent as "corrections" to an ongoing argument.

It is a quirky, upbeat, pseudo-ska-inspired jangle-pop anthem for anyone who has ever wanted to deliver a curse via a local florist. The track captures a polite "congratulations" that hides a sharp, poisonous warning between the gems.

For fans of: The Smiths, Blondie, The Clash
Tempo: Fast / Driving
Vibe: Sharp, nostalgic, spiteful
Key: C Major

Credits:
Songwriting, instruments & production: Sondersted
Vocals: Prosey Q

Label: Isle Valley Records

data.description:
Built on a restless 128 BPM pulse and sharp, crystalline guitar lines, "Alibi" is a study in the darker side of jangle-pop. The track, written in D Minor, delivers a high-energy rhythmic foundation that contrasts with a detached, cool vocal performance.

Under the Sugargrapes moniker, this release continues the project's exploration of 80s melodic brightness combined with 90s-inspired lo-fi grit. It is designed for high-contrast environments—sharp, nostalgic, and intentionally detached.

Part of Isle Valley Records.
Genre: Alt-Indie / Postpunk Jangle Pop

Credits:
Songwriting, Instruments & Production: Sondersted
Vocals/Featured Artist: Prosey Q/Sugargrapes
